paper_identity.title: One- and two-phonon wobbling excitations in triaxial 165Lu

cross_mass_significance: Establishes the microscopic mechanism of octupole parity-doubling suppression in Triaxial Superdeformed (TSD) bands in rare earths (163Lu, 165Lu): proves that large triaxial elongation (beta2 ~ 0.40, gamma ~ 20 deg) splits the Delta l = Delta j = 3 octupole shell gap condition into non-degenerate K=0,1,2,3 components pushed above Ex > 2.5 MeV, while macroscopic dipole moment cancellation quenches B(E1) to < 10^-5 W.u., refuting the transfer of actinide alternating-parity octupole models to TSD regimes.
